_note: One row per data explorer. retrieved is the date the figures were last pulled from the source, taken from the data file's own date; null means no date is recorded and the weekly report asks for one. as_of_date is a date the source itself gives (a release or a cut-off); as_of_text names the source's edition or round where it gives no single date. review_every_days is a proposed interval for the owner to adjust. scripts/check-explorer-freshness.py reads this file; scripts/build-explorer-freshness.py writes the visible line on each page.
